Implemented Story 2.3 and marked it `review`.

- Added authenticated personal-list/detail services, exact DTO APIs, strict IDs, current-role authorization, four-state filtering and descending ordering.
- Added `/my`, navigation, safe text details, loading/empty/error/session states and keyboard flows.
- Added independent fixtures, 9 Python tests, 12 JavaScript handler tests and isolated browser verification.
- Updated README and story acceptance checkboxes.

Verification: **100 unique Python tests + 44 JavaScript tests passed**, no skips. Desktop/mobile history and existing booking/replay browser flows passed. Real 20-client creation/replay, audit rollback and restart regressions passed. History reads preserved all stored business data.

Evidence: [Story 2.3 verification](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/docs/evidence/story-2.3-verification.md).

No required work remains incomplete. Cancellation remains deferred as specified. No Git or remote operations were performed.
我会逐项修复状态说明、键盘焦点、测试断言和进程清理，只运行覆盖这些改动的定向测试，并把新证据保存到独立目录。

已修复全部评审项：

- 明确列表快照、详情本次读取及手动刷新；失效时同步两面板提示并保留失败区域焦点。
- 修复筛选后焦点丢失，增加真实键盘顺序、DOM 编号/状态和实际渲染响应断言。
- 加强到期边界、读取快照、完整 DTO 与详情字段独立断言。
- 增加 Node、Chromium、Waitress 独立进程组清理及强制回收。
- 补源码/验证依赖指纹、实际版本；元数据失败先使旧 PASS 失效。

仅运行定向验证：**10 项 Python、17 项 JS、3 项运行器测试通过**；桌面/手机历史浏览器及真实 Chrome 失败/超时清理探针通过，无残留进程。

新证据：[评审修复验证](/Users/mima0000/Documents/Codex/2026-11-12/bmad-b/outputs/group-room-booking/docs/evidence/story-2.3-review-fixes/verification.md)。旧证据未改。
